q.q: What is the Operator pattern?
o: A way to implement reusable software that manages complex workloads
A method for scaling pods horizontally
A way to package Helm charts into images
q.e: Operator 模式是實作可重複使用軟體、管理複雜 Workload 的方式，例如含資料庫、Backend 與 Front-end 的應用程式與其備份、更新工作。

q.q: How does a cluster administrator typically describe a complex workload that an operator manages?
q.e: Cluster 管理員建立 Custom Resource 描述複雜 Workload，Operator 監看 CR 並建立、管理對應的 Kubernetes 資源。

q.q: A database operator detects a database CR that includes a backup schedule. What might the operator create?
o: A StatefulSet, persistent volumes, and a CronJob for backups
q.e: 範例中資料庫 Operator 會建立 StatefulSet 與 Persistent Volume；若 CR 描述了備份排程，還會建立 CronJob 依排程備份。

q.q: Which component installs and updates cluster operators as part of installing and updating OpenShift?
q.e: CVO 在安裝與更新 OpenShift 時，安裝並更新 Cluster Operator。

q.q: Which component manages add-on operators?
q.e: 由 OLM 管理的 Operator 稱為 Add-on Operator，為 Cluster 增加功能，有別於提供平台服務的 Cluster Operator。

q.q: Which of these is an example of a service provided by cluster operators?
o: The web console and the OAuth server
q.e: Cluster Operator 提供 OpenShift 的平台服務，例如 Web Console 與 OAuth Server。

q.q: How do the lifecycles of cluster operators and add-on operators differ?
o: CVO updates cluster operators with the cluster version, while OLM manages add-on operators independently of cluster updates
Both are updated only by OLM
Both are updated only with the cluster version
q.e: Cluster Operator 由 CVO 隨 Cluster 版本安裝與更新；Add-on Operator 由 OLM 獨立於 Cluster 更新來管理。

q.q: Besides cluster and add-on operators, how can software vendors distribute operators?
o: With manifests, Helm charts, or other mechanisms
Only through the Red Hat catalog
q.e: 軟體供應商可依 Operator 模式建立軟體，並以 Manifest、Helm Chart 或其他機制散布。

q.q: Which command shows the status of cluster operators?
q.e: CVO 以 ClusterOperator 資源提供 Cluster Operator 的狀態；oc get clusteroperator 可了解 Cluster 的健康狀況。

q.q: Where can you view ClusterOperator resources in the web console?
q.e: 在 Web Console 的 Administration → Cluster Settings，點選 ClusterOperators 頁籤檢視。

q.q: What is an operator catalog?
o: A container image that provides information about available operators, such as descriptions and versions
A list of installed operators in a ConfigMap
A web page on the Red Hat customer portal
q.e: Operator Catalog 是 Container Image，提供可用 Operator 的資訊給 OLM，例如描述與可用的版本。

q.q: Which default catalog contains operators supported by independent software vendors and Red Hat partners?
q.e: Certified 目錄由獨立軟體供應商與 Red Hat 夥伴支援；Red Hat 目錄由 Red Hat 封裝與支援；Community 由開源社群支援。

q.q: Which catalog's operators are developed and supported by the open source community?
q.e: Community 目錄由開源社群開發與支援。

q.q: What does OLM create for each operator available in a catalog?
q.e: OLM 為每個可用的 Operator 建立一個 PackageManifest，列出可用的 Channel 與版本，可用 Subscription CR 安裝。

q.q: Why does the course recommend pulling operator images only from trusted private registries?
o: It helps protect the software supply chain and maintain digital sovereignty
It is required for the CVO
q.e: 可建立自己的目錄或為離線 Cluster Mirror 目錄；只從受信任的私有 Registry 拉取 Image，有助於保護軟體供應鏈與維持數位主權。

q.q: What two parts make up an operator?
o: A set of custom resource definitions and a Kubernetes workload
A Helm chart and a values file
q.e: Operator 由一組 CRD 與一個 Kubernetes Workload 組成，Workload 使用 Kubernetes API 監看 CR 並建立對應的 Workload。

q.q: Each operator in a cluster has two sets of workloads. Who manages each set?
o: OLM manages the operator's own workload, and the operator manages the workloads associated with its CRs
The operator manages its own workload, and OLM manages the CR workloads
q.e: 一組是 Operator 本身的 Workload，由 OLM 管理；另一組是與 CR 關聯的 Workload，由 Operator 管理。

q.q: Which tool provides support for developing operators with Go and Ansible and packaging Helm charts as operators?
q.e: Operator SDK 可以 Go 與 Ansible 開發 Operator，也可把 Helm Chart 封裝為 Operator。

q.q: Which tool develops operators in Java and includes a Quarkus extension?
q.e: Java Operator SDK 以 Java 開發 Operator，含 Quarkus 擴充套件，可用 Quarkus 框架開發。

q.q: Where in the web console do you browse and install available operators?
q.e: 在 Ecosystem → Software Catalog 檢視可用的 Operator 並以安裝精靈安裝；安裝前先檢閱 Operator 資訊與文件。

q.q: In the Install Operator wizard, what does the Update Channel option define?
o: The version stream that the operator subscription tracks, such as stable or fast
The namespace for the operator workload
Whether updates are automatic or manual
q.e: Update Channel 是 Operator Subscription 追蹤的版本串流，例如 stable 或 fast。

q.q: What is the default installation mode in the Install Operator wizard, and what does it mean?
o: All namespaces on the cluster; the operator watches CRs in all namespaces
A specific namespace; the operator watches only its own namespace
Manual; the operator waits for approval
Single node; the operator runs on one node
q.e: Installation Mode 預設為 All namespaces on the cluster，適合大多數 Operator，Operator 會監看所有 Namespace 的 CR。

q.q: What is the difference between Installation Mode and Installed Namespace?
o: Installation Mode determines which namespaces the operator watches; Installed Namespace determines where the operator workload runs
Installed Namespace determines which namespaces are watched
q.e: Installation Mode 決定 Operator 監看哪些 Namespace；Installed Namespace 是 Operator Workload 所在的 Namespace，兩者相關但不同。

q.q: How does OLM handle operator updates by default, and how can you prevent automatic updates?
o: OLM updates automatically by default; choose manual Update Approval to prevent it
q.e: Update Approval 預設自動更新；選擇手動可避免自動更新。

q.q: Which resources does the Install Operator wizard create based on the selected options?
q.e: 安裝精靈會依選項建立 Subscription 與 OperatorGroup 資源，其他資源由 OLM 產生。

q.q: What is a Cluster Service Version (CSV)?
o: A resource for each operator version that contains the information OLM needs to install the operator
The version of the OpenShift cluster
A Secret that stores operator credentials
q.e: 每個 Operator 版本都有 CSV，OLM 用其資訊安裝 Operator，並更新 status。

q.q: An operator watches multiple namespaces. Where do its CSVs exist?
o: In each watched namespace, because CSVs are namespaced
q.e: CSV 屬於 Namespace；監看多個 Namespace 的 Operator，在每個 Namespace 都有 CSV。

q.q: In the Installed Operators details page, which tab lets you change the update channel and approval strategy and links to the install plan?
q.e: Subscription 頁籤可更改 Update Channel 與核准方式，並連到 Install Plan，手動更新時就在這裡核准。

q.q: What is the primary mechanism for interacting with an operator?
o: Running oc exec in the operator pod
q.e: Custom Resource 是與 Operator 互動的主要機制；CR 類型依 Operator 而異。

q.q: What is a limitation of the form view when creating a custom resource in the web console?
o: It might not provide fields for every option
It creates the resource in the wrong namespace
q.e: 表單檢視逐一編輯欄位並有說明與下拉選單，但可能沒有所有選項的欄位；YAML 檢視則提供範本與 Schema 文件。

q.q: Which resources should you examine to troubleshoot an operator installation problem?
o: The status and conditions of the CSV, Subscription, and Install Plan
q.e: 安裝問題需檢視 CSV、Subscription 與 Install Plan 的 status 與 Condition，並參閱 Operator 文件。

q.q: In the web console exercise, which resource is the operator workload created by OLM for the File Integrity Operator?
q.e: file-integrity-operator Deployment 是 OLM 建立的 Operator Workload；建立 FileIntegrity 後，Operator 才建立 aide-example-fileintegrity DaemonSet。

q.q: In the File Integrity exercise, what appears after a file is created on a node and a check runs?
o: A failed ConfigMap whose report includes the added file
q.e: 以 oc debug 在 Node 建立檔案後，會出現 failed ConfigMap，報告含新增的檔案 (例如 /hostroot/etc/foobar)。

q.q: When installing an operator from the CLI, which resources must the administrator create?
o: Subscription and OperatorGroup (and the namespace if needed); OLM generates the rest
q.e: 安裝時管理員只需建立 Subscription 與 OperatorGroup (必要時建立 Namespace)，其他資源由 OLM 自動產生。

q.q: What does a CatalogSource resource reference?
o: An operator repository that OLM checks periodically
An image registry for application images
q.e: Catalog Source 參照 Operator Repository，OLM 定期檢查並取得 Operator 資訊。

q.q: What does an OperatorGroup define?
o: How OLM presents operators across namespaces, that is, which namespaces the operator watches
q.e: Operator Group 定義 OLM 如何在 Namespace 之間呈現 Operator，也就是 Operator 監看哪些 Namespace。

q.q: In which namespace are the default CatalogSource resources located?
q.e: 以 oc get catalogsource -n openshift-marketplace 列出 Catalog Source。

q.q: Which command provides the catalog source, channels, current CSV, and supported install modes for an operator?
q.e: 描述 Package Manifest 可取得 Catalog Source 與其 Namespace、Channel、目前 CSV、套件名稱與支援的 Install Modes。

q.q: Why can the classroom lab complete the course without internet access?
o: It has a single local catalog that provides the operators needed for the course
It uses the community catalog cached in the browser
q.e: 實驗環境只有一個目錄，在本機提供課程所需的 Operator，因此可離線完成課程。

q.q: Which OperatorGroup exists in the openshift-operators namespace, and what does it do?
o: global-operators; operators installed there use it and watch all namespaces
cluster-operators; it is used by the CVO
q.e: openshift-operators 內含 global-operators OperatorGroup，安裝到該 Namespace 的 Operator 使用它並監看所有 Namespace。

q.q: In an OperatorGroup, how can you specify the namespaces the operator watches?
o: List them in spec.targetNamespaces, or select them by label with spec.selector
q.e: 另建 OperatorGroup 時，以 targetNamespaces 列出要監看的 Namespace，也可用 spec.selector 以 Label 選取。

q.q: Where do the channel, name, source, and sourceNamespace values for a Subscription come from?
o: The CSV of the previous version
q.e: Subscription 的 channel、name、source 與 sourceNamespace，取自描述 Package Manifest 所得的資訊。

q.q: Which values can spec.installPlanApproval take in a Subscription?
q.e: installPlanApproval 為 Automatic 或 Manual。

q.q: With installPlanApproval set to Automatic, what happens when a new version appears in the subscribed channel?
o: OLM waits for an administrator to approve
OLM ignores it until the next cluster update
q.e: Automatic：新版本一出現在訂閱的 Channel，OLM 立即更新。

q.q: With installPlanApproval set to Manual, what does OLM do when a new version is available?
o: Creates an InstallPlan but does not approve it; an administrator must approve it
Sends an email to the administrator
q.e: Manual：OLM 建立 InstallPlan 但不核准，管理員檢閱後核准，OLM 才安裝新的 CSV。

q.q: How do you identify an install plan that is waiting for approval?
o: Its APPROVED column shows false in 'oc get installplan'
q.e: 待核准的更新，oc get installplan 的 APPROVED 狀態為 false。

q.q: Which command approves the install plan install-qrlwl in metallb-system?
o: oc patch installplan install-qrlwl --type merge -p '{"spec":{"approved":true}}' -n metallb-system
q.e: 核准方式是用 oc patch 把 Install Plan 的 spec.approved 設為 true。

q.q: Which field of the Operator resource references the install plan?
q.e: Operator 資源的 status.components.refs 參照 Install Plan，可用 oc describe operator 找出。

q.q: How do you change the update channel of an installed operator from the CLI?
q.e: 以 oc patch subscription NAME --type merge -p '{"spec":{"channel":"NEW"}}' 變更；Automatic 時可能觸發更新，Manual 時可能建立需核准的 Install Plan。

q.q: Which CSV field lists the CRDs that the operator defines?
q.e: CSV 的 spec.customresourcedefinitions 列出 Operator 定義的 CRD；spec.install.spec.deployments 則列出 OLM 安裝時建立的 Deployment。
